data_fields.name: buy_modifier
data_fields.donor_constant: buyModifier (per shop, percent; floor 10 on priceMod)

data_fields.name: sell_modifier
data_fields.donor_constant: sellModifier (per shop, percent; floor 10 on priceMod)

data_fields.name: price_modifier
data_fields.donor_constant: priceModifier (per shop; offset = priceModifier x stock gap, clamp -100..100)

data_fields.name: restock_period
data_fields.donor_constant: respawnRate in ms, ceil(ms / GAME_TICK) ticks, repeating

data_fields.name: restock_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 unit per restock toward base; custom lines -1 per restock, removed at 0

best_idea: a vendor's price moves with its own stock (scarce goods cost more, surplus pays less) and the stock drifts back to its base one unit per server tick, so the economy corrects itself with no designer editing prices
decision_why: adopt the stock-sensitive price with a 10 percent floor, +/-100 clamp and one-tick restock; fix the integer truncation to 0 coins and the forward removal loop; per-vendor modifiers and base stock are zone data; reject the retro price branch because Frankendom has one client and one price rule
acceptance: A vendor with base 10 potions sells 3: the next unit costs more than default by priceModifier x 3 percent before the clamp; after three restock ticks stock is 10 and price is back to default; a 1-coin item at the floor sells for 1 coin, not 0
